raw_segments.text: Olivia, oh, what a deal of scorn looks beautiful in the contempt and anger of his lip. A murderous
guilt shows not itself more soon than love that would seem hid. Love's night is noon.
Caesareo, by the roses of the spring, by maidhood, honor, truth, and everything, I love thee
so, that mogger all thy pride, nor wit nor reason can my passion hide. Do not extort
thy reasons from this clause, for that I woo, thou therefore hast no cause, but rather reason
thus with reason fetter. Love sought is good, but given unsought is better.
